name: Chris Murphy
committees: Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions
stance: Backs Connecticut's 2026 AI legislation and wants Congress to regulate AI as well.

statements.text: The only value that guides the AI industry right now is the pursuit of profit. In all my meetings, it was crystal clear that companies like Google and Apple and OpenAI and Anthropic are in a race to deploy consumer-facing, job-killing AGI as quickly as possible, in order to beat each other to the market. Any talk about ethical or moral AI is just whitewash
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: Every single executive I met with admitted that they had built a machine that they could not understand or control.
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: A fraud is being perpetuated on the American people and our pliant, gullible political leaders.
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: That China has been actively building towards a national AI law, while producing a cutting-edge model like DeepSeek’s, makes clear that AI regulation and innovation can, and do, co-exist.
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: I want to beat China in the race for advanced AI. I do. But not at any cost. If we do not use government policy and intervention to control for the job loss and to protect consumers, it won’t matter that we get to AGI before China.
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: The leaders of these companies, brimming with dangerous hubris, rapacious in their desire to build wealth and power, and far too comfortable in shrugging off the destructive power of their product
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: Regulating AI isn't a gift to China – it's a way to make sure that we manage the growth of AI in a way that makes sure that we beat the Chinese in this race.
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: A mandate for an American leader to prioritize working internationally to regulate AI doesn't come from nowhere. The industry right now is spending millions of dollars trying to suppress conversation in the United States at the state level, and at the federal level, around a regulatory framework
statements.outlet: Office of Sen. Chris Murphy (press release, via Capitol Releases archive)

statements.text: While Trump and Big Tech team up to stop any regulation of AI, Connecticut is taking an important first step to put people's safety and job security over billionaire profits. Time for Congress to do the same.
